capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: 82 kWh gross pack has 77 kWh usable (VW figure relayed by SlashGear 2023 first drive; Wikipedia table gives 82/77 for 2021-22 too). Same 82 kWh pack carried to MY2021 (cell supplier LG in 2021-22 vs SK On from 2023).

dc_max_kw.notes: Launch cars were 125 kW (VW 2021 release); Green Car Reports: 2022 peak 135 kW versus the previous 125 kW via OTA update (Software 3.0); Wikipedia agrees. Recorded as the figure after the update; unupdated cars may still be 125 kW. MY2021 cars take the update over the air.
